test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which organisation, in collaboration with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), and the Ministry of Education, announced the launch of the ‘AI For All’ initiative with the purpose of creating a basic understanding of artificial intelligence for everyone in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intel**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intel** has collaborated with the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** and the **Ministry of Education** to launch the **'AI For All' initiative**.
 
• The purpose of the **'AI For All' initiative** is to create a basic understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) for everyone in India.
 
• The initiative aims to demystify AI for the general public and help people understand the potential of AI in various aspects of life and work.
 
• The program is designed to be accessible to people from all walks of life, regardless of their age, education, or profession.
 
• This collaboration is part of Intel's broader commitment to promoting AI literacy and technological education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** is a national level board of education in India for public and private schools, controlled and managed by the Government of India.
 
• The **Ministry of Education**, formerly known as the **Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD)**, is responsible for the development of human resources in India.
 
• Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that aims to create systems capable of performing tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation.
 
• Intel has been at the forefront of AI research and development, contributing significantly to advancements in AI technologies and applications.
